effect.caverns_and_chasms.subtle.descrip: An effect that hides all potion particles.
lore.spicedcider.candle_holder_glowlight: A candle holder fitted with Glowlight Candles.
lore.spicedcider.candle_holder_sulfur: A candle holder fitted with Sulfur Candles.
lore.spicedcider.carved_pale_pumpkin: A pale pumpkin with an eerie face carved into it. It can be worn to safely look at Wanderers, or used to build Snow and Iron Golems.
lore.spicedcider.cheerful_clay_statue: A little clay figure with its arms flung wide. Offered at a Moonlight Basin, it delights the Friend Moon, and the clouds part. Found in old alchemist ruins.
lore.spicedcider.glowlight_candle: A candle that burns with a dim glowlight flame.
lore.spicedcider.gold_candle_holder_glow: A bronze candle holder fitted with Glowlight Candles.
lore.spicedcider.gold_candle_holder_sulf: A bronze candle holder fitted with Sulfur Candles.
lore.spicedcider.hide: The raw skin of a big animal, dropped by Cows, Horses, Goats, Deer, Wolves, Bears and similar creatures. Killing one with a Knife yields an extra Hide. Stretched on a Tanning Rack and cured with Tree Bark, it becomes Leather.
lore.spicedcider.large_sulfur_jack_o_lan: A slice of a large carved pumpkin lit by a Sulfur Torch.
lore.spicedcider.lavender_tea_mug: A Mug of calming Lavender tea.
lore.spicedcider.mournful_clay_statue: A little clay figure weeping into its hands. Offered at a Moonlight Basin, it moves the Friend Moon to tears, and rain follows. Found in old alchemist ruins.
lore.spicedcider.pale_bush: A withered, colourless shrub found in pale gardens.
lore.spicedcider.pale_cupric_jack_o_lant: A carved pale pumpkin lit by a Cupric Torch.
lore.spicedcider.pale_glowlight_jack_o_l: A carved pale pumpkin lit by a Glowlight Torch.
lore.spicedcider.pale_jack_o_lantern: A carved pale pumpkin lit by a Torch.
lore.spicedcider.pale_pumpkin: A ghostly white pumpkin that grows in pale gardens. Shears carve a face into it.
lore.spicedcider.pale_redstone_jack_o_la: A pale pumpkin which smiles at you, and will alight with a flux signal.
lore.spicedcider.pale_rose: A colourless rose that blooms in pale gardens.
lore.spicedcider.pale_soul_jack_o_lanter: A carved pale pumpkin lit by a Soul Torch.
lore.spicedcider.pale_sulfur_jack_o_lant: A carved pale pumpkin lit by a Sulfur Torch.
lore.spicedcider.sconce_sulfur: A sconce holding a choking blue sulfur flame.
lore.spicedcider.sulfur_brazier: A brazier that burns with a choking blue sulfur flame.
lore.spicedcider.sulfur_campfire: A campfire that burns on sulfur. Its fumes leave anyone standing in the flames, or eating food cooked over it, feeling queasy.
lore.spicedcider.sulfur_candle: A candle that burns with a dim blue sulfur flame.
lore.spicedcider.sulfur_jack_o_lantern: A carved pumpkin lit by a Sulfur Torch.
lore.spicedcider.sulfur_lantern: A lantern holding a choking blue sulfur flame. Dimmer than a regular Lantern.
lore.spicedcider.sulfur_torch: A torch that burns with the choking blue flame of sulfur. Dimmer than a regular Torch.
lore.spicedcider.tall_pale_bush: A tall, withered, colourless shrub found in pale gardens.
lore.spicedcider.tanning_rack: A tall frame for stretching Hides. Rub Tree Bark into a stretched Hide and it slowly cures into Leather; a thick Hoglin Hide cures into several pieces at once. Take the Leather off by hand.
lore.spicedcider.wormy_dirt: A patch of dirt teeming with Worms. Breaking it drops several Worms unless mined with Silk Touch. Chickens, Ducks, and Turkeys fed Corn Kernels will go hunting for it.
lore.spicedcider.worm: A wriggly critter dug up from Wormy Dirt or found in Composters and Cans of Bait. As fishing bait it slightly speeds up bites. It can be gilded into a Golden Worm.
lore.spicedcider.grub: A fat larva that sometimes turns up when breaking Podzol, Mycelium and giant mushroom blocks, or in Cans of Bait. As fishing bait it decently speeds up bites.
lore.spicedcider.minnow: A tiny fish that sometimes darts out of Seagrass when it is cut, or turns up in Cans of Bait. As fishing bait it slightly speeds up bites and slightly improves catches.
lore.spicedcider.firefly: A glowing beetle sometimes shaken out of grass and ferns at night, or found in Cans of Bait. As fishing bait it decently improves catches.
lore.spicedcider.golden_worm: A Worm coated in Gold, sometimes found in Cans of Bait. As fishing bait it significantly speeds up bites.
lore.spicedcider.worm_crate: A crate packed with Worms, for compact storage.
lore.spicedcider.golden_worm_crate: A crate packed with Golden Worms, for compact storage.
lore.spicedcider.deposit: A lumpy stone vein found underground that breaks into Geodes. Mine it with Silk Touch to keep the block.
lore.spicedcider.deepslate_deposit: A lumpy deepslate vein found deep underground that breaks into Deepslate Geodes. Mine it with Silk Touch to keep the block.
lore.spicedcider.blackstone_deposit: A lumpy blackstone vein found in the Nether that breaks into Blackstone Geodes. Mine it with Silk Touch to keep the block.
lore.spicedcider.map_in_a_bottle: A corked bottle with a rolled-up map inside, sometimes fished up from the open ocean. Open it to find a Cartographer's Quill that charts the way to a random landmark: buried treasure, a warm ocean ruin, an ocean monument, a jungle or desert temple, a witch hut, a mineshaft, an abandoned camp or even an ancient city.
lore.spicedcider.ruined_page: A scorched, water-stained page torn from a book nobody remembers writing. Turns up in dungeon chests and in suspicious sand and gravel. Use it to read the two voices written on it; 31 pages make up the whole conversation.
lore.spicedcider.geode: A rock with something inside. Crack it open with a Hammer on a Workstone to see what it holds. Also found in dungeon chests and fished up from underground water.
lore.spicedcider.deepslate_geode: A deepslate rock with something inside. Crack it open with a Hammer on a Workstone to see what it holds.
lore.spicedcider.blackstone_geode: A blackstone rock from the Nether with something inside. Crack it open with a Hammer on a Workstone to see what it holds. Can be fished up from lava.
lore.spicedcider.tallow: Animal fat rendered from Pork or Beef in a Cooking Pot. Used for frying, Soap, and Candles. Burns in a Furnace.
lore.spicedcider.cast_iron_ingot: A brittle, heavy ingot forged from Iron and Coal. Used for Cauldrons, Hoppers, Minecarts, and other ironmongery.
lore.spicedcider.cast_iron_nugget: A small piece of Cast Iron that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.spicedcider.cast_iron_block: A solid block of Cast Iron.
lore.spicedcider.cast_iron_sheet: Cast Iron flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press. Used to make Chutes and Cleavers.
lore.spicedcider.fire_striker: A single-use firestarter knapped from Flint. Lights a fire or a Campfire, then crumbles.
lore.spicedcider.ceramic_mug: A fired ceramic mug for holding teas, ciders and compotes.
lore.spicedcider.grappling_hook: A hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Instead of fishing, the line latches onto blocks so you can reel yourself in. Good for climbing, not for fish.
lore.spicedcider.sticky_grappling_hook: A Grappling Hook coated in slime. It sticks to walls instead of bouncing off them.
lore.spicedcider.flux_hook: A Bronze hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Gives you a larger catch zone in the fishing minigame.
lore.spicedcider.gold_hook: A Gold hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Slightly improves catches.
lore.spicedcider.heavy_hook: A Steel and Lead hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Favours larger fish, which fight more slowly.
lore.spicedcider.light_hook: A Rose Gold hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Casts much farther, and hooked fish fight more slowly.
lore.spicedcider.double_hook: A Diamond hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Has a chance to catch two fish at once.
lore.spicedcider.prismarite_hook: A Prismarite hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Decently improves catches when fishing in open ocean.
lore.spicedcider.featherlight_hook: A Valkyrium hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Hooked fish can never escape the minigame.
lore.spicedcider.necromium_hook: A Necromium hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Bait is never used up.
lore.spicedcider.adamantite_hook: An Adamantite hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Allows fishing in Dimensional Tears.
lore.spicedcider.rubber_cable: A flexible cable made from Rubber. It can be strung between fences and walls like a chain.
lore.spicedcider.blast_proof_plating: Gold plates forged with Creeper Spores to absorb blasts. Crafted into Mischief armor.
lore.spicedcider.mischief_helmet: Armor made from Blast-Proof Plating that reduces explosion damage by a quarter. A full set shrugs off explosions entirely, and Piglins ignore its wearer.
lore.spicedcider.mischief_chestplate: Armor made from Blast-Proof Plating that reduces explosion damage by almost a third. A full set shrugs off explosions entirely, and Piglins ignore its wearer.
lore.spicedcider.mischief_leggings: Armor made from Blast-Proof Plating that reduces explosion damage by a quarter. A full set shrugs off explosions entirely, and Piglins ignore its wearer.
lore.spicedcider.mischief_boots: Armor made from Blast-Proof Plating that reduces explosion damage by a fifth. A full set shrugs off explosions entirely, and Piglins ignore its wearer.
lore.spicedcider.infernite_cleaver: A brutal Cleaver upgraded with Infernite. A fully charged swing while standing still sends out a shockwave that knocks back and slows nearby enemies. Mobs slain with it can drop their heads.
lore.spicedcider.piglin_broadsword: A heavy golden blade carried by Piglins and their zombified kin. Hits harder than a Golden Sword but swings slower.
lore.spicedcider.piglin_battleaxe: A brutal golden axe wielded by Piglin Brutes. Hits harder than a Golden Axe but swings slower.
lore.spicedcider.latex_bucket: Milky sap tapped from Kapok logs. Pour it into a Basin and press it with a Mechanical Press to set a Block of Rubber, or mix it hot with Sulfur Dust for Rubber.
lore.spicedcider.latex_bottle: Milky sap tapped from Kapok logs with a Tap and a Cauldron. Four bottles fill a Bucket.
lore.spicedcider.resin_bucket: Sticky sap tapped from Spruce, Pine and Fir logs. Pour it into a Cauldron to scrape out Resin, or press it in a Basin.
lore.spicedcider.maple_syrup_bucket: Sweet syrup tapped from Maple logs. Pour it into a Cauldron to bottle it, or use a Spout to glaze Pears.
lore.spicedcider.resin_oil_bucket: Flammable oil rendered from Resin. Pour it into a Cauldron to bottle it, or pipe it into a Spout.
lore.spicedcider.chromarine: A vivid prismarine stone that forms reefs on warm ocean floors and in the Prismatic Seep, where Chromatic Brambles take root.
lore.spicedcider.achromarine: A pale prismarine stone that forms reefs on cold and deep ocean floors and in the Prismatic Seep, where Achromatic Brambles take root.
lore.spicedcider.sulfide: A dark mineral crust deposited around hydrothermal vents on the floor of the Abyss.
lore.spicedcider.sulfide_vent: A chimney of Sulfide that rises from hydrothermal vents in the Abyss. Black smoke pours from its top, along with bubbles while underwater.
lore.spicedcider.calcite_vent: A pale Calcite chimney that rises from hydrothermal vents in the Abyss. White smoke pours from its top, along with bubbles while underwater.
lore.spicedcider.tubeworm: A colony of worms living on the floor of the Abyss. They hide in their tubes when a swimming player comes near. Shear the top to collect 4 Red Dye, or use any Dye on them to change their colour. Sheared plumes grow back over time.
lore.spicedcider.budding_prismarine: A Prismarine block found atop the prismarine spires of the Prismatic Seep. Prismarine Buds slowly grow on its sides, in air or water.
lore.spicedcider.small_prismarine_bud: The first stage of a Prismarine Cluster, growing from Budding Prismarine. Only drops itself when mined with Silk Touch.
lore.spicedcider.medium_prismarine_bud: The second stage of a Prismarine Cluster, growing from Budding Prismarine. Only drops itself when mined with Silk Touch.
lore.spicedcider.large_prismarine_bud: The third stage of a Prismarine Cluster, growing from Budding Prismarine. Only drops itself when mined with Silk Touch.
lore.spicedcider.prismarine_cluster: A fully grown crystal from Budding Prismarine. Mining it drops 4 Prismarine Shards.
lore.spicedcider.chromatic_bramble: A colourful underwater shrub that grows on Chromarine reefs. It can only be placed in water.
lore.spicedcider.tall_chromatic_bramble: A tall colourful underwater shrub that grows on Chromarine reefs. It can only be placed in water.
lore.spicedcider.achromatic_bramble: A pale underwater shrub that grows on Achromarine reefs. It can only be placed in water.
lore.spicedcider.tall_achromatic_bramble: A tall pale underwater shrub that grows on Achromarine reefs. It can only be placed in water.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_log: The thin, branching wood of the Cacao Tree. It joins up with neighbouring Cacao Logs and fills out with leaves when surrounded by them.
lore.spicedcider.stripped_cacao_log: A Cacao Log with its bark stripped away by an axe.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_wood: Cacao bark on every side, for building with the branching Cacao shape.
lore.spicedcider.stripped_cacao_wood: Cacao Wood with its bark stripped away by an axe.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_leaves: Leaves of the Cacao Tree. Drops Cacao Saplings.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_pod: A ripe pod picked from the Cacao Tree. Its tough husk has to be cut open with a knife to get at the Cocoa Beans inside.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_sapling: A plant that grows into a small Cacao Tree, whose leaves grow Cacao Pods.
lore.spicedcider.flowering_cacao_leaves: Blossoming leaves of the Cacao Tree. Cacao Pods sprout beneath them over time, or right away with Bone Meal. Drops Cacao Saplings.
lore.spicedcider.pear_log: The thin, branching wood of the Pear Tree. It joins up with neighbouring Pear Logs and fills out with leaves when surrounded by them.
lore.spicedcider.stripped_pear_log: A Pear Log with its bark stripped away by an axe.
lore.spicedcider.pear_wood: Pear bark on every side, for building with the branching Pear shape.
lore.spicedcider.stripped_pear_wood: Pear Wood with its bark stripped away by an axe.
lore.spicedcider.pear_leaves: Leaves of the Pear Tree. Drops Pear Saplings.
lore.spicedcider.flowering_pear_leaves: Blossoming leaves of the Pear Tree. Pears sprout beneath them over time, or right away with Bone Meal. Drops Pear Saplings.
lore.spicedcider.pear_sapling: A plant that grows into a Pear Tree, whose blossoming leaves grow Pears.
lore.spicedcider.avocado_log: The thin, branching wood of the Avocado Tree. It joins up with neighbouring Avocado Logs and fills out with leaves when surrounded by them.
lore.spicedcider.stripped_avocado_log: An Avocado Log with its bark stripped away by an axe.
lore.spicedcider.avocado_wood: Avocado bark on every side, for building with the branching Avocado shape.
lore.spicedcider.stripped_avocado_wood: Avocado Wood with its bark stripped away by an axe.
lore.spicedcider.flowering_avocado_leave: Blossoming leaves of the Avocado Tree. Avocados sprout beneath them over time, or right away with Bone Meal. Drops Avocado Saplings.
lore.spicedcider.deepsilt: Fine black sediment that settles on the floor of the Abyss. It falls like sand.
lore.spicedcider.algae: A slimy mat of Algae found on swamp and river beds. Underwater, it spreads onto nearby Sand and Gravel when Kelp grows close by. Bone Meal spreads it faster.
lore.spicedcider.algal_gravel: Gravel overgrown with Algae, found on ocean floors among Kelp. It spreads to nearby Sand and Gravel while underwater near Kelp.
lore.spicedcider.algal_sand: Sand overgrown with Algae, found on ocean floors among Kelp. It spreads to nearby Sand and Gravel while underwater near Kelp.
entity.spicedcider.sputter.description: A small golem built from a Carved Pumpkin on top of a Barrel. Load it with a stack of Arrows and it shoots at nearby monsters, or at anything that hurts it. Tipped Arrows keep their effects. Use an empty hand to take the Arrows back, or a Dye to give it war paint. Drops Sticks when destroyed.
lore.spicedcider.music_disc_jynweythek: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Dungeon chests.
entity.spicedcider.straw_golem.descripti: A small golem built from a Carved Pumpkin on top of a Hay Bale. It harvests fully grown crops nearby, replants them and carries the harvest to the nearest container. Sneak and use an empty hand on it, then on a container, to choose where it delivers. Wheat patches it up, a Barrel lets it shrug off hits, and a Sun Hat keeps the rain off. Cows, pigs and sheep like to nibble on it.
item.spicedcider.straw_hat.description: A hat for a Straw Golem. Use it on one to keep the rain off its head.
lore.spicedcider.travelers_pouch: A drawstring pouch of odds and ends, left behind by someone who packed for the road. Open it to see what they carried.
lore.spicedcider.witchs_pouch: A dark pouch that smells of mushrooms and something sharper. Open it for a handful of brewing supplies.
lore.spicedcider.bait_can: A dented can with something wriggling inside. Open it for fishing bait.
lore.spicedcider.tin_can: An empty, dented tin can. Grind it down to recover its metal.
lore.spicedcider.seed_pouch: A drawstring pouch of seeds and saplings, sometimes left behind by travellers. Open it to see what grows.
lore.spicedcider.copper_javelin: A spear that can be hurled at enemies by holding and releasing use. Pick it back up where it lands.
lore.spicedcider.rose_gold_javelin: A spear that can be hurled at enemies by holding and releasing use. Pick it back up where it lands.
lore.spicedcider.silver_javelin: A spear that can be hurled at enemies by holding and releasing use. Pick it back up where it lands.
lore.spicedcider.electrum_javelin: A spear that can be hurled at enemies by holding and releasing use. Pick it back up where it lands.
lore.spicedcider.necromium_javelin: A spear that can be hurled at enemies by holding and releasing use. Pick it back up where it lands.
lore.spicedcider.bonded_hide: Hide pressed and stitched into a soft, solid block. It can be pulled apart into Hide again.
lore.spicedcider.bonded_hoglin_hide: Bristly Hoglin Hide pressed and stitched into a solid block. It can be pulled apart into Hoglin Hide again.
lore.spicedcider.tin_sheet: Tin flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.spicedcider.lead_sheet: Lead flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.spicedcider.rose_gold_sheet: Rose Gold flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.spicedcider.silver_sheet: Silver flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.spicedcider.electrum_sheet: Electrum flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.spicedcider.netherite_sheet: Infernite flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.spicedcider.necromium_sheet: Necromium flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.spicedcider.prismarite_sheet: Prismarite flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.spicedcider.valkyrium_sheet: Valkyrium flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
